spans.s:
अब्द m. (-ब्दः)
 1. A cloud.
 2. A year.
 3. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus
rotundus.)
 4. The name of a mountain.
 E. अप् water, प changed to
ब, and द what gives; or अब to preserve, &c. and दन् Unādi affix;
hence the word is also written अब्द.

अब्दशत n. (-तं) A century.
 E. अब्द, and शत a hundred.

अब्दसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A thousand years.
 E. अब्द, सहस्र a thousand.

अब्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) A half year.
 E. अब्द, and अर्द्ध half.

अब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Annual, yearly.
 E. अब्द and ठन् aff.

अब्दुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A fortress surrounded by a moat or lake.
 E. अप् water, and
दुर्ग fort.
